title_sq: Shitet Vile ne Liqeni e Farkes
description_sq:
Shitet Vile e bashkengjitur me pamje nga Liqeni te Farkes.
Vila eshte me 4 kate, dhe mundesi parkimi per 2 makina. 
Ne katin -1 ndodhet nje sallon me dalje ne oborr, kuzhina e veçuar, nje tualet, nje dhome teknike, nje depo dhe nje ambjent per sauna.
Ne katin 0 salloni i dyte me pamje fantastike nga Liqeni si dhe nje Tualet.
Ne katin 1-re jane 3 dhoma gjumi, 3 tualete . 
Ne katin 2-te gjendet nje studio e vogel, tualeti dhe nje dhome gjumi, nje verande dhe pamje gati 360grade nga Liqeni. 
Vila eshte e pajisur me certifikate pronesie
Çmimi eshte nje mundesi e mire, siper investim dhe per banim, per vetem 1650 Euro/m2, 
Per me shume info na kontaktoni!
title_en: Villa for sale in Lake Farke
description_en: Attached villa with a view of Farkes Lake for sale. The villa has 4 floors, and parking for 2 cars. On the 1st floor there is a living room with access to the courtyard, a separate kitchen, a toilet, a technical room, a storage room and a sauna area. On the 0th floor, the second living room with a fantastic view of the lake and a toilet. On the 1st floor there are 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms. On the 2nd floor there is a small studio, a toilet and a bedroom, a veranda and an almost 360 degree view of the lake. The villa is equipped with ownership certificates. The price is a good opportunity, for investment and for living, for only 1650 Euro/m2. For more information, contact us!
